2	import { daysBetween } from './dates.js';

4	/**
5	 * Get all overdue invoices as of a given date.
6	 * @param {Array} invoices - Array of invoice objects
7	 * @param {string} asOf - Cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array} - [{number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due}], sorted by most overdue first
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  return invoices
12	    // Only issued or partially_paid status
13	    .filter((inv) => inv.status === 'issued' || inv.status === 'partially_paid')
14	    // Only invoices with dueDate before asOf
15	    .filter((inv) => inv.dueDate < asOf)
16	    // Map to report format
17	    .map((inv) => ({
18	      number: inv.number,
19	      customerId: inv.customerId,
20	      dueDate: inv.dueDate,
21	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf),
22	      due: balanceDue(inv),
23	    }))
24	    // Sort by most overdue first (earliest dueDate = most overdue)
25	    .sort((a, b) => a.dueDate.localeCompare(b.dueDate));
26	}
